# Problem 

We are now going to look at what we call "the distribution of averages". To obtain this, we will take random samples of size `n` from our collection of female observations. We will sample the females with replacement, meaning that it is possible for an observation to appear more than once in our sample. The following code chunk defines a function that takes samples of size n, with replacement, and then returns the average value of that sample. 

```{r}
get_avg <- function(x, n){
  mean(sample(x, size = n, replace = TRUE))
}

# Example of calling the function to obtain the average of 5 randomly

```
